column1: # Pairs of hand-written closed lists in different files that share members, each with
# the count it shares: file, name, file, name, shared count and an optional reason
# (tab-separated). A pair is judged by its count: it may shrink, never grow. A reason,
# `value-model` or `layer`, is one the guard derives from the sources (closed_lists.jet
# CLOSED_LIST_PAIR_REASONS); a row whose reason no longer holds fails. Rows without a
# reason are open duplicates: they are removed, never added.
# This row records an overlap that already existed (27 shared members before and after
# the build-action rename), not new duplication, logged on #6129 as known debt. Under the
# shared-count rule it can only shrink.
